source_note: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题
english_source_note: Criteria for Density of Sequences in an Interval
callout_id: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题#7
statement_en: If $a_k>0$, $a_k\to 0$, and the series $\sum_{k\ge 1} a_k$ diverges, then for the partial sums $S_n:=\sum_{k\le n} a_k$, the fractional parts $Q_n:=\{S_n\}$ are dense in $[0,1)$.
key_techniques: apply density modulo 1 to partial sums
callout_body: 如果$a_k>0,a_k\to 0$,并且级数$\sum_{k\geq 1}a_k$发散，那么其部分和序列$S_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}a_k$的小数部分$Q_n:=\{S_n\}$在区间$[0,1)$中稠密。
